meta.title: Vendor sees their current zone and can bid to move zones

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow required for configuring a traffic-light auction.
Configure the auction bands so bids above 120 are red and bids at or below 80 are green.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add one product for the vendor's bid sheet.
Populate the pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite the QA vendor that will submit and revise the bid.
Verify the auction reached a real published event page.
Continue in the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the auction's vendor bid sheet.
Submit an initial bid above the upper band to establish the starting zone.
Verify the vendor's initial bid was submitted.
Assert that the vendor can see the current red traffic-light zone.
Revise the same vendor's bid into the green band to test movement between zones.
Verify the revised bid was submitted.
Assert that the displayed zone updates to green after the revised bid crosses the configured band.
